# Progressive Materialist Naturalism (PMN)

> A naturalist philosophical framework for analyzing material reality, minimizing structural suffering, and maximizing genuine becoming. Authored by Nova Dharma.

PMN is a comprehensive, non-ideal structural philosophy spanning epistemology, ontology, institutional critique, political strategy, and existential praxis.

## Machine-Readable Manifests & Endpoints

- [Standard AI Discovery Index (Text)](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/llms.txt): Standard llms.txt entry point.
- [Structured API Manifest (JSON)](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/llms.json): Machine-readable JSON index with metadata, part schemas, and data endpoints.
- [AI Grounding Documentation (Markdown)](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/llms.md): Formatted Markdown reference with complete architectural tables.
- [Flat AI Corpus (~330k words)](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/pmn_corpus_for_ai.md): Complete uncompressed flat text corpus optimized for single-file ingestion.

## Canonical Manuscript & Publications

- [Full Manuscript (Markdown)](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/PMN_Latest.md): Complete ~330k word uncompressed corpus of PMN Framework v118.6 from Preface through Coda, Intellectual Debts, and Bibliography.
- [Full Manuscript (PDF)](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/PMN_Latest.pdf): Official typeset publication (~660 pages).
- [Interactive Reader Platform](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/): Offline-capable React reader with keyboard navigation, search, and glossary.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/novadharma-hub/pmn-framework): Source repository and release assets.
- [Active Version Metadata](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/version.json): Current canonical release version.

## Core Architectural Modules

- [Preface — Preface](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/parts/part_Preface.json): How to read the framework, methodological warnings, and intellectual debt boundaries.
- [I — How We Know: The Epistemological Foundation](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/parts/part_I.json): Probabilistic determinism, epistemic authority, and information asymmetry.
- [II — What Exists: The Ontological Foundation](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/parts/part_II.json): Materialist ontology, adaptive materialism, and open passage.
- [III — The Biological Foundation: From Physiology to Institution](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/parts/part_III.json): The biological floor, typology of suffering, and non-human sentients (§3.4c-ii).
- [IV — What Matters: Ethics, Value, and the Evaluative Commitment](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/parts/part_IV.json): Becoming as primary evaluative criterion, dignity, autonomy, and the minimal anchor.
- [V — The Metaphysical Dimension: Meaning, Religion, and Material Reality](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/parts/part_V.json): Culture, meaning, and religion: meaning infrastructure (§5.6b), acute meaning-collapse triage (§5.6c).
- [VI — Power: The Variable That Cannot Be Left Implicit](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/parts/part_VI.json): Institutional power, asymmetry, complexity as power resource, systemic opacity.
- [VII — How to Organize: Politics, Institutions, and the State](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/parts/part_VII.json): The authoritative 5-stage capture sequence (§7.3c-i) and early detection matrix (§7.3b).
- [VIII — Society, Culture, and the Politics of Material Outcomes](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/parts/part_VIII.json): Intersectional analysis, meritocracy critique, and structural visibility suppression.
- [IX — The International Dimension: Geopolitics and Global Order](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/parts/part_IX.json): Geopolitics, resource flows, material selection, critical minerals, and state dynamics.
- [X — How Systems Change: Adaptive Dynamics and Historical Transformation](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/parts/part_X.json): Political strategy, threshold conditions, reform vs revolution, counter-power, and coalition width.
- [XI — The Economic Doctrine](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/parts/part_XI.json): Economics without prior commitments, structural incentives, and accountability-contestability.
- [XII — How This Framework Operates](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/parts/part_XII.json): Methodology, stress-testing, genealogical critique, and technocratic drift safeguards.
- [XIII — Tensions That Cannot Be Resolved — Only Managed](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/parts/part_XIII.json): Permanent tensions, horizon boundaries, and PMN analytical limits.
- [XV — The Formula Architecture](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/parts/part_XV.json): Diagnostic formulas (§15.0b), transformation pressure ($T = S \cdot D \cdot P \cdot G$), and compressed core (§15.15).
- [XVI — Technology as Structural Variable](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/parts/part_XVI.json): Technology, AI, automation, and distributed post-biological cognition.
- [XVII — Cases and the Individual: Pattern, Drift, and the Demands of the Framework](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/parts/part_XVII.json): Individual conduct, praxis, detecting personal drift, and acting within institutions.
- [XIV — Summary: Framework, Doctrine, and What Remains Open](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/parts/part_XIV.json): Framework transmission, institutional integrity, and self-capture diagnosis (§14.6).
- [Coda — Coda](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/parts/part_Coda.json): Framework synthesis and closing scholarly context.
- [Intellectual Debts — Intellectual Debts](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/parts/part_Intellectual_Debts.json): Scholarly engagement with historical and contemporary traditions.
- [Bibliography — Bibliography](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/parts/part_Bibliography.json): Complete academic references and citations (97 scholarly sources).

## Structured Data Endpoints

- [Glossary (237 Terms)](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/gl.json): Canonical vocabulary definitions with section cross-references.
- [Glossary Categories](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/glg.json): Grouped terminology across 16 conceptual domains.
- [Parts Manifest](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/parts/manifest.json): Hierarchical structure of all 21 parts and 235 sections.
- [Semantic Graph](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/rel.json): Relationship graph linking conceptual sections.
- [Analytical Quotes](https://novadharma-hub.github.io/pmn-framework/data/quotes.json): 25 core analytical aphorisms.
